description: A modern two-storey residential exterior photographed at night from the garden, showing a wide establishing view of the facade and garden. The house is clad in smooth white or light grey render with large format panels, with a second storey balcony featuring a simple metal bar railing. The ground floor opens with large floor-to-ceiling sliding glass panels and a fixed glazed section, revealing a warmly lit interior dining area with a table and chairs glowing amber-orange from within. Adjacent to the sliding door, a panel of vertical narrow dark wood slats — possibly cedar or teak — runs from the terrace roof height to the ground, adding a warm textural accent against the white render. The ground floor terrace is surfaced in light stone or polished concrete with low planted beds of ornamental shrubs at its edge. The garden in the foreground is a wide expanse of manicured short grass, glowing bright green from the ground-level light sources. Two low ground-staked flood light units with white rectangular bodies sit in the grass aimed toward the facade, casting broad warm pools of amber-yellow light upward across the turf and onto the planting bed. The evening sky is a deep blue gradient above, transitioning to warm amber from the interior. The contrast between the deep blue night sky, the warm amber interior glow through the glass, and the yellow-green grass illumination creates a layered dramatic night exterior atmosphere.
